name: ZCA_SALES_CONTENTS
description: This table stores content items from Oracle Content Experience system along with information about related parent objects like lead,campaign etc.

columns.name: SALES_CONTENT_ID
columns.description: Auto generated Primary Key of the table

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the parent object like Lead/Campaign etc. that owns this content item

columns.name: PARENT_OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Id of the Parent Object like Lead/Campaign etc. that owns this content item

columns.name: CONTENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Content Item Id of the content from Oracle Content and Experience - this content is used inside the organization

columns.name: PUBLIC_CONTENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Public Content Item Id of the content from Oracle Content and Experience - this content is for public consumption and visible via outbound channels

columns.name: PUBLIC_CONTENT_ITEM_NAME
columns.description: Content Item name for public profiles

columns.name: PUBLIC_CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer represented via this content - used for public profiles

columns.name: PUBLIC_CONTENT_PUBLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Content publish date for public profiles

columns.name: DELETED_IN_SOURCE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if deleted in OCE

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Display sequnece for the Content item

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
